_comment: Item templates by name. icon: iconsTK.xml number. slot: vgmsg.EQUIP_SLOTS name the item equips to (omit for non-equipment). mesh: [mesh type, mesh number] shown on the character (docs/GEAR.md); omit for no model. Placeholder data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md). type: weapon/shield/armor/ranged/jewelry. damage: [min, max], delay: seconds, skill: weapon skill stat id (198 one-handed slashing, 227 longsword, 109 one-handed blunt, 43 short sword), armor: armor class, level: required level, rarity: name colour 0..11. Harvesting tools: type harvest_tool, slot HARVESTTOOL (0x35), harvest: the resource kind it works on (mining, lumberjacking, ...). rarity: mundane (default, white name), common (green), uncommon (blue), rare (yellow), heroic (orange), fabled (purple), legendary (red); group loot rolls items at or above the group's threshold. fireworks: an ITEM_ABILITIES id played on use; fireworks_fx: the emitter class spawned at the player (docs/ABILITY_VISUALS.md "Fireworks").

Travel Rations.description: Restores 40 health. Can be eaten once every 30 seconds.

Bone Charm.description: Raises two bone servants for a minute.

Experience Debt Clearance.description: Clears all of your experience debt. (Placeholder name: the client only knows the template id.)

Small Pouch.description: A small leather pouch. Holds 8 items.

Dire Wolf Harness.description: Summons a dire wolf to ride.

Desert Camel Lead.description: Summons a desert camel to ride.

Griffon Whistle.description: Summons a griffon. In the air, jump again to take flight.

Bear Claw.description: A curved claw from a thornback bear.

Spider Silk.description: Strong, sticky silk from a webweaver.

Forester's Cloak.description: A warden's cloak, given to friends of the forest.

Salvage Kit.description: Right-click, then click a piece of equipment to break it down. One use per kit.

Shimmering Dust.description: Fine dust left by deconstructing an item.

Brass Spyglass.description: Right-click to look through it; again to lower it.
